Documentation.name: Dastan Technology
Documentation.notes: Stereotypes and toolboxes Dastan reads to generate ENOVIA/3DEXPERIENCE MQL: the administrative schema (types, attributes, relationships, policies, roles), the ENOVIA Web widget UI, and REST service annotations for class diagrams.

Documentation.name: PLM Schema Profile
Documentation.notes: Type, Attribute, Relationship, Policy, Role, State and Trigger stereotypes for the ENOVIA/3DEXPERIENCE administrative schema. Read by Dastan's Schema, Policy and Trigger Script Generators to produce MQL.

Documentation.name: Widget Profile
Documentation.notes: Stereotypes for ENOVIA Web / Widget Center UI configuration: widgets, settings, commands, menus, portals, tables, forms, fields and the connectors between them. Read by Dastan's UI Script Generator.

Documentation.name: Controller Profile
Documentation.notes: REST controller and endpoint stereotypes for documenting service APIs on an ordinary class diagram. Not read by any Dastan generator.

Documentation.name: Schema Profile
Documentation.notes: Toolbox page for drawing schema elements: Type, Attribute, Role, Policy, states, triggers and relationships.

Documentation.name: Widget Profile
Documentation.notes: Toolbox pages for drawing widget UI elements and the connectors between them.
